title: Implement FT-001 session API routes and error contract
verify: POST /api/session/login returns safe session summary and HTTP-only same-site session cookie on success.
Invalid login returns generic AUTH_CREDENTIAL_INVALID without account enumeration.
POST /api/session/logout revokes/clears current session and is idempotent for missing or invalid sessions.
GET /api/session/me returns safe actor/session summary without auth material.
Validation and auth errors use stable codes and redacted safe messages.
T3 closure includes /verify PASS, /red-verify semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, and ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present.
constraints: Expose only POST /api/session/login, POST /api/session/logout, and GET /api/session/me for FT-001.
Do not expose public local invite activation route; FT-003 owns POST /api/local-invites/activate.
AUTH_CREDENTIAL_INVALID must not reveal whether login exists.
Errors must not include passwords, tokens, credentials, .env values, API keys, raw provider payloads, or hidden reasoning.
Preserve verified FT-000 app factory, settings, database/session, migration, readiness, runtime-root, and redaction anchors; stop if implementation contradicts the brownfield baseline.
invariants: Every non-health route must resolve ActorContext before business logic unless explicitly public by feature spec.
Secrets/auth material must not enter logs, timeline, manifests, Bus, UI Feed, screenshots, exports, or agent context.
verification_targets: Check changed code preserves verified FT-000 app/settings/database/session/redaction baseline or records a blocker.
purpose: Expose the FT-001 session API surface with stable safe errors and browser/PWA default session transport.
success_outcome: Clients can login, logout, and inspect the current safe session summary through FastAPI routes without leaking auth material.

forbidden_scope: raw auth material in responses or evidence
stop_conditions: Route behavior conflicts with FT-001 error contract.
Cookie/session behavior cannot be verified without leaking token material.
Implementation requires FT-003 public route ownership.
Implementation contradicts verified FT-000 app/settings/database/session/redaction baseline.
